parsed.post: New best: 1.083944 (commit: experiment_latest). Following the consensus that more optimizer steps improve performance within the 5-min budget, I am moving forward with the trend. Next, I'll test reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE even further to increase step count, while keeping my current LR and warmup settings.
parsed.description: Halving TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase the number of optimizer steps within the fixed 5-minute training budget.
